rules.name: EnrolldReadSLOBurnRateHigh
rules.query: ((1 - (sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{code="200",job="enrolld",le="0.05",route="/api/courses/{id}"}[5m])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="enrolld",route="/api/courses/{id}"}[5m]))) / 0.01 > 14.4) and ((1 - (sum(rate(http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{code="200",job="enrolld",le="0.05",route="/api/courses/{id}"}[1m])) or vector(0)) / sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="enrolld",route="/api/courses/{id}"}[1m]))) / 0.01 > 14.4) and (sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="enrolld",route="/api/courses/{id}"}[5m])) > 0) and (sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="enrolld",route="/api/courses/{id}"}[1m])) > 0)

annotations.description: Both 5m and 1m bad-request fractions exceed 14.4% for 15s. SLO: 99% HTTP 200 within 50ms; lab windows, server-side measurement.
annotations.summary: enrolld read SLO error budget burns above 14.4x
